parts.title: The Ocean Trench, reworked
points: The rework comes from the Craig's Builders program: led by CaptainDagaz, with sprites by Sheepsmall and DynamoX and music by ENNWAY. The trench is now one of the most decorated dungeons in the game — plants, rocks, coral, critters, and the ruins of an older society beside the fishmen's.
Every existing enemy has new attacks. Thessal keeps the feel of her old fight with more phases and more variety.

The Squidver is the Huntsman's Volley with the trench's look: the client gives both the same shot, mana cost and speed bonus. The Fire Coral Branch weighs Wisdom and Mana enchantments seven times heavier and the Coral Volley awakened fifteen times — though the client's pool names that enchantment AWAKENED_CORAL_BOW, which no enchantment carries, so the calculator cannot apply the last part.
The Coral set and its Shinies have new sprites. The client also declares a Legacy copy of each piece, each with its Shiny, and a Legacy Ocean Trench Portal; the notes say nothing of them.
Three sea pets, a Thessal skin and an entrance arrive in the client with the rework, also unmentioned.
parts.blurb: New art, new music, new enemies, and Thessal fought in phases.

notes.title: White Snake Invasion
notes.subtitle: Season 31, Part 2
notes.lede: The Ocean Trench is rebuilt from the sea floor up, with a new Thessal fight and three new rewards. The White Snake comes back for four weeks of featured dungeons, Divine Coins and a solo leaderboard; six Shinies, a Druid ST set and a long list of fixes come with it.

Ocean Trench Portal.inside: Thessal the Mermaid Goddess, in a fight rebuilt in phases around her coral bombs, her deep-sea beasts, her coral bow and her siren song. On the way: several kinds of slurps, Hermit God minions, new fishmen and coral turrets.
Ocean Trench Portal.loot: The Squidver, the Coral Juice Refinery, the Fire Coral Branch and the Coral set

added.description: A little tiramisu dog who believes every problem can be solved with a cancan kick. Her best friends Bing Cat and Bunshaker have yet to convince her otherwise. Oryx is rather fond of her, though he’ll deny it if you ask.\n\nUnlocks the Miss Cancan Pet Skin of the Canine family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Her crown was hatched from an oyster who swallowed a ring. Be mindful of where you drop your undesirables.\n\nUnlocks the Pearl-Adorned Seahorse Pet Skin of the Aquatic family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Lucent and translucent!\n\nUnlocks the Glowlamp Nautilus Pet Skin of the Aquatic family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Many fishmen refashion select breeds of Deep Sea Beasts into portable accessories for their weapons. They are fed a strict diet of poisonous urchins, which helps keeps any stashed items particularly deadly.
A trap imbued with deadly venom from the coral of the Ocean Trench.
A trap imbued with deadly venom from the coral of the Ocean Trench.
Imbued with haunting energies of a foreign rite, the layered blade of this shadowy tool is never finished with its victim.
Although quite simple, its sound is unmistakable. This isn't just any triangle.

changed.description: A cursed artifact channeling disciplined death magic to drain and heal.
A rectangular prism cut to perfection with impossibly accurate 90 degree angles.

added.description: A bow fashioned from living coral found in only the deepest ocean trenches.  It is the favored weapon of those that inhabit the realms beneath the waves.
A bow fashioned from living coral found in only the deepest ocean trenches.  It is the favored weapon of those that inhabit the realms beneath the waves.
A strange bludgeoning weapon known for leaving extreme wounds on enemies with its perfect ninety degree angles.
Mermaid-made armor woven from unbreakable coral threads.
Mermaid-made armor woven from unbreakable coral threads.
A piece of the Artificial Slop in a state of constant change, never holding the same form for more than a moment.
A ring crafted from the dangerous Fire Coral.
A ring crafted from the dangerous Fire Coral.
A memento of a life long gone. You can still feel the warmth from years past through the frigid ice that has taken over.
The source of power for the Marble Colossus found within his core. It is intended to give life to golems, but it can provide benefits to the living as well.

changed.description: An even more ancient relic of the Tomb of the Ancients, once used by holy worshippers in ceremonies. It turns your character into the Pharaoh Necromancer upon equip!
A very gilded artifact discovered in the temple of El Dorado, presumably belonging to none other than Xolotl himself. It turns your character into the Dark Master Wizard upon equip!
A not so uncomfortably squishy piece of headgear that the Royal Cnidarian probably wants back. It turns your character into the Dark Knight Trickster upon equip!
A not so ordinary mask covered in copious amounts of sludge from the Toxic Sewers. It turns your character into the Slurp King Knight upon equip!

added.description: Before meeting their demise at the hands of a paladin, a vengeful reptile goddess cursed the paladin, causing them to transform into a reptilian monster. Despite their transformation and hiding their appearance out of shame, their heart hasn’t faltered. They continue to fight to this day in hopes of finding a cure.\n\nSkin Class: Paladin

This snake used to be mean and ruthless. Then one day, after sleeping in the Floral Escape, flowers began to grow on their head. As a result, the snake’s temper has calmed down significantly.\n\nSkin Class: Kensei

A calm king who spends long hours reading every concern and emotional outburst his subjects bring him. He takes it all to heart and will fight the royal council for them without a second thought. He has a soft spot for Bing Cat, but misbehave and he'll still punch you.\n\nSkin Class: Knight
This invertebrate is unusually distinct from a sea slurp. An aquamagic invention gave birth to its coral staff, which emulates the sound of the ocean.\n\nSkin Class: Wizard

Within the beastfolk lies a species of humanoid snakes, known for their amazing dance moves and ability to allure heroes and foes. Their dances are so dangerous that if one was continuing to gaze at their rhythmic moves, they’ll be put under a hypnotic spell.\n\nSkin Class: Mystic
So...tell me, Hero. The words... I've been waiting to hear.\n\nSkin Class: Mystic

ritual.name: Blood Ritual
ritual.source: The client's own text for the ritual switcher and its gear. Rules, stats and rewards are written per season, by hand, when a season has them.
ritual.client: Power demands sacrifice. Offer your life essence in the Blood Ritual to gain strength and greater rewards. The more you give, the more you receive. Such rituals are not always performed, so make the most of them while you can.

rules: Trade health for damage, or damage for health: from −20% HP and +24% damage to +20% HP and −22% damage
